description: Invoicing SPA: clients + invoices, live net/VAT/gross line items, statuses, print/PDF via @media print, JSON export/import, validation + toasts. Hash routing + localStorage.

criteria: invoice-pilot.html is one self-contained invoicing SPA (hash routing + localStorage, no frameworks): clients CRUD; an invoice builder with a line-items table computing net/VAT/gross live; statuses Draft/Sent/Paid/Overdue; an invoice preview with a print / save-as-PDF button and a dedicated @media print layout; JSON export/import; validation with inline errors, toasts and confirm dialogs.
